decision.reason: [ev-006461aa3c80] is just a changelog title ("Fix application url for custom base href (#21377)"). It doesn't name the component or setting involved, describe the URL behaviour before and after the fix, say which environments are exposed beyond a vague "custom base href", or say what happens if an operator does nothing. To write the assertion we would need the PR #21377 description or diff, or release-note text that states the before/after behaviour.
